summary: This standards-track document defines an SDP attribute for negotiating image attributes such as picture size. A small device can say what sizes it can display so the sender doesn't need to scale. This saves memory and processing power on low-end devices.

eli5.summary: A small phone screen can tell the sender what picture size it likes, so the sender sends that size and the phone doesn't have to shrink it.

questions: how to negotiate video resolution in sdp
what is the sdp image attribute
